title: Fast intention route has no linked route or view coverage
reasoning: The owned change exposes /fasts/<int:fast_id>/intention/ through FastIntentionView, but the associated fast view test module only imports and exercises FastListView, FastByFeastDateView, and serializer behavior. There is no visible test that reverses the fast-intention URL, calls the endpoint, verifies the fast_id kwarg is accepted, or checks the expected auth/error behavior for this user-input route. That leaves regressions in URL wiring or endpoint permissions likely to slip through.
recommendation: Add focused tests for the fast-intention endpoint covering URL resolution and at least the primary success and missing/invalid fast cases, including whatever authentication or permission contract FastIntentionView is supposed to enforce.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included fast view tests cover list, feast-date lookup, caching, church scoping, and serializer day numbering, but no visible test references FastIntentionView or the fast-intention route.
suggestedRegressionTest: In hub/tests/test_fast_views.py, add tests using reverse('fast-intention', kwargs={'fast_id': fast.pk}) or a client request to /api/fasts/<id>/intention/ that assert the expected status and response for an existing fast, plus a nonexistent fast_id case.
minimumFixScope: Test-only change for hub/tests/test_fast_views.py unless the new test reveals a route/view contract bug.
